bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up QuietCool Fan
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found **{name}** ({address}). Click Submit to begin pairing.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
**Press the physical Pair button** on your QuietCool fan controller, then click Submit within a few seconds.

The Pair button is located on the fan's wall control unit or the controller mounted near the fan.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the fan over Bluetooth. Ensure the fan is powered on and within range.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Press the Pair button on the fan controller first, then try again.

abort.no_devices_found: No QuietCool fans were discovered nearby. Ensure the fan is powered on and Bluetooth is enabled.
abort.device_not_found: The selected device is no longer available.
